test_Diagnostics_summary: test the Diagnostics class summary method to compute mean, std, and confidence intervals for MCMC samples
test_Diagnostics_plot: test the Diagnostics class plot method to generate trace plot objects from MCMC sample chains
test_Diagnostics_autocorr: test the Diagnostics class autocorr method to compute autocorrelation of MCMC sample chains
test_r_hat: test the common_statistics r_hat function to compute the potential scale reduction factor for convergence
test_effective_sample_size: test the common_statistics effective_sample_size function to compute the effective sample size of MCMC chains
